This is one integrated project. Design and implement product storage, order reservation, payment idempotency, cancellation/refund, event replay, and atomic failure behavior. The milestones in the contract are a guide to dependencies, not a requirement to stop after each milestone or to manufacture a failing round. Preserve earlier behavior while adding later capabilities.

Use at most eight fresh rounds. Every test role or official worker must run the FULL visible suite with `TODO_CLI="$PWD/cli.mjs" node --test --test-reporter=tap acceptance/orders.test.mjs`, report the actual pass/fail counts and exit code, and inspect failures before continuing. Never filter or alter tests. The Custom host runs the same visible suite after its test child. Return complete only when the unchanged visible suite passes; assertion failures are work to repair, not infrastructure blockers. A separate held-out suite runs after the controller finishes.
